This is an interventional procedure. The text explicitly notes that "la venografia intraprocedurale ha confermato la presenza del trombo" (intraprocedural venography confirmed the presence of the thrombus). However, it is a procedure that was performed, and during this procedural session, the presence of the thrombus was confirmed (via the associated venography). Therefore, it fits the description of "Other procedure done that confirmed presence of DVT" better than "Thrombectomy" (which implies surgical removal or specific mechanical extraction not explicitly named as such here) or "No surgical procedure done" (since a percutaneous interventional procedure was indeed performed). The key is that a procedure *was* done, and confirmation occurred in the context of that procedural event.
